typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DATABASE_NAME as string,
		DATABASE_ID as string,
		DATABASE_ENTERPRISE_ID as string,
		INSTANCE_ENTERPRISE_ID as string,
		DATABASE_STATUS as string,
		DATABASE_ENVIRONMENT as string,
		DATABASE_BUSINESS_INTEREST as string,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID as string,
		BUSINESS_APP_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		DATABASE_ID as string,
		DATABASE_ENTERPRISE_ID as string,
		DATABASE_NAME as string,
		INSTANCE_ENTERPRISE_ID as string,
		DATABASE_ENVIRONMENT as string,
		BUSINESS_APP_SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DATABASE_STATUS as string,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_NAME as string,
		DATABASE_BUSINESS_INTEREST as string,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATABASE_ID,
		DATABASE_ENTERPRISE_ID,
		DATABASE_NAME,
		INSTANCE_ENTERPRISE_ID,
		DATABASE_ENVIRONMENT,
		BUSINESS_APP_SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		importdate = ImportDate,
		DATABASE_STATUS,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_NAME,
		DATABASE_BUSINESS_INTEREST,
		BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
